## Overview & Core Philosophy
Anton Mykhailov specializes in systems programming, device & chip orchestration, and high-efficiency architectures:
- Minimal resource overhead (0 KB VRAM / Headless architectures)
- High battery life and performance for mobile & embedded devices
- 100% on-device data processing (no tracking, zero third-party telemetry, no analytics SDKs)
- Native, mobile, graphical, and embedded platforms: Android (Kotlin/Java), robotics & industrial control (ROS 2, Modbus TCP, OPC UA, PLC), VM/bytecode engines, TUI environments, and competitive game AI.

---

## Published & Featured Projects

### 1. Tdroid (TUI Desktop & Launcher for Android)
- **Platforms**: Android (Free & Pro editions on Google Play)
- **Description**: Ultra-lightweight terminal/TUI desktop environment for Android smartphones and tablets. Replaces heavy graphical launchers with an efficient, keyboard-first text console interface.
- **Embedded Engine**: Powered by **TDscript v1.0.1 (Legacy / Stable)** for terminal scripting and shell shortcuts.
- **Key Features**:
  - Pure terminal interface with instantaneous launch time and minimal battery consumption (9–15 MB RAM footprint).
  - Built-in multitasking, app management, file navigation, and system diagnostics.
  - Zero telemetry and full offline capability.

### 2. TDscript Core 1.1 / TDModules v1.4.0 — Universal Device, Chip & Robotics Platform
- **Platforms / Scope**: Cross-platform (Linux, Windows, Android, Embedded, Robotics, GUI & TUI Applications)
- **Release Status**: Stable Release v1.4.0 (Core 1.1 Specification compliant) alongside v1.0.1 (Legacy Stable)
- **Documentation**: https://fido2465724100-creator.github.io/my-developer-site/tdscript/
- **Two Coexisting Generations**:
  1. **TDscript v1.4.0 / Core 1.1 (Modern / Studio / AI-First)**:
     - Hexadecimal literals: `0x76`, `0xD0`, `0xF4`, `0x1000L`
     - Deterministic byte array formatting (`[0x60]`) and indexing `bytes[i]` (returns 0..255)
     - `LString` symbolic resources with `{varName}` scope interpolation (concatenation with `+` strictly prohibited via `TDS_E105`)
     - Strict method dispatch: `TDS_E106: E106@line:col unknown_method=<name> on=<type>`
     - Hardware watchdog subsystem: `WATCHDOG.feed()`, `WATCHDOG.emergencyStop()`
     - Spatial sandboxing: `CapabilityScope` address whitelisting (I2C: `0x76`, Modbus: `100..200`)
     - AI compact repair lines: `E104@1:5 exp=0x76 got=0x68` and formal GBNF grammar (`docs/tdscript-core-1.1.gbnf`)
  2. **TDscript v1.0.1 / Core 1.0 (Classic / Legacy Stable)**:
     - Maintained across Tdroid Launcher and older Android host apps
     - Numeric literals: Decimal only (`118`, `208`)
     - Symbolic `LString` resources (without `{var}` interpolation)
     - Standard multi-line JSON error diagnostics (`CompilerErrorDiagnostic.toJson()`)
- **Deterministic Bytecode (.tbc)**: Binary opcode compilation (2–10 KB) with Ed25519 digital signatures and SHA-256 integrity checks.

### 3. TDscript Studio IDE & Autonomous AI Agentic Loop
- **Platforms**: Desktop (Linux / Windows) & Android (Mobile App)
- **Downloads Hub**: https://fido2465724100-creator.github.io/my-developer-site/tdscript/studio.html
- **Official Packages (v1.1.0)**:
  - Debian/Ubuntu: `downloads/tdscript-studio_1.1.0-1_amd64.deb` (47 MB)
  - Fedora/RHEL/openSUSE: `downloads/tdscript-studio-1.1.0-1.x86_64.rpm` (47 MB)
  - Universal AppImage: `downloads/tdscript-studio-1.1.0-x86_64.AppImage` (54 MB)
  - Portable Tarball: `downloads/tdscript-studio-1.1.0-linux-x64-portable.tar.gz` (56 MB)
  - Universal Fat JAR: `downloads/tdscript-studio-linux-x64-1.1.0.jar` (31 MB)
  - Android APK: `downloads/tdscript-studio-1.1.0.apk` (5.5 MB, USB-OTG + BLE)
- **Key Architecture & Features**:
  - Autonomous Agentic Loop: *Hardware Discovery (`probe()`) ➔ Prompt Construction with JSON environment ➔ Code Generation ➔ Execution in `AiHardwareSandbox` ➔ Machine-readable error capture (`CompilerErrorDiagnostic`) ➔ Automated code fix (up to 3–5 iterations)*.
  - Zero-Dependency `LlmClient` for local LLMs (Ollama: `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`, LM Studio: `http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1`) and cloud APIs.
  - Live language projection switcher (RU/EN/DE) without touching string literals or comments.

### 4. Global LLM Benchmark (3B–9B Models)
- **Report & Full Telemetry**: https://fido2465724100-creator.github.io/my-developer-site/tdscript/benchmark.html
- **Model Tested**: Qwen 3.5 9B Instruct on `llama-server` (CUDA GTX 1070).
- **Core Results**:
  - TDscript Experimental achieved **90.0% Final Success** with lowest LOC across all 7 languages (**5.6 lines** vs 9.7 Python, 15.0 C++, 13.5 Kotlin).
  - Cost per success reduced by 45% (2275.2 tokens vs 4149.9 in Base) thanks to compact repair error syntax.

### 5. TDRobotics (Android Robotics Engineering Environment)
- **Platforms**: Android (Standalone Engineering Tool)
- **Description**: Mobile CAD and programming suite for building, simulating, and validating physical circuits and robots.
- **Key Features**: Parametric physical IC package generator (DIP-8 to DIP-40), deterministic circuit analyzer (overvoltage protection 5V -> 3.3V), and multi-target exporter (APK, EXE, AppImage, JAR).

### 6. Sevens & Nines («Сімки та Дев'ятки» / «Семёрки и Девятки»)
- **Platforms**: Android (Google Play) & Linux/Desktop
- **Description**: Cross-platform card game simulator featuring classic Eastern European Nine (36 cards) and International Sevens (Parliament / Fan Tan, 52 cards) with heuristic AI bots.

### 7. TCM Canons («Каноны ТКМ: Древняя Мудрость»)
- **Platforms**: Android (Capacitor/Vite), Web
- **Description**: Interactive educational encyclopedia for Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) treatises with 3D acupoints atlas and certification exam.
